text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills edged down to 38.70 percent from 40.64 percent at the last sale on January 17, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 12.74 million UAH 10.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 11.62 million UAH 9.08 million UAH
The central bank sold 127,374 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 21,819 were competitive and 105,555 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 23.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills fell to 47.04 percent from 53.31 percent at the last sale on January 17, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 15.00 million UAH 10.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 12.15 million UAH 7.90 million UAH
The central bank sold 150,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 2,250 were competitive and 147,750 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 23.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills fell to 54.61 percent from 57.27 percent at the last sale on January 17, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of nine-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 15.00 million UAH 10.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 10.65 million UAH 7.00 million UAH
The central bank sold 150,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 23.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills slipped to 59.76 against 59.88 percent at the last sale on January 17, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 109.34 million UAH 1.79 million UAH
Actual amount raised 68.51 million UAH 1.34 million UAH
The central bank sold 1,093,430 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 1,089,902 were competitive and 3,528 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for January 23.
